mitigations.issue: Frozen audit settings could diverge from hard-coded runtime values
mitigations.verification: TrackBAuditPolicy is built from validated v3 execution lock; mutation tests reject operational-threshold drift.

mitigations.issue: Frozen external-family-order seed was previously sealed but unused
mitigations.verification: Seeded PCG64 representative ordering is executed before sealing; traversal-invariance test passes.

mitigations.issue: Candidate ORB descriptors could accumulate in Python memory
mitigations.verification: Candidate ORB cache is file-backed/packed under scratch storage with mmap reads.

mitigations.issue: Nested OpenCV/Python threading could oversubscribe Kaggle CPU
mitigations.verification: v3 runtime policy fixes OpenCV internal threads to one while worker pool remains bounded.

mitigations.issue: Raw external/model material could remain in autosaved /kaggle/working
mitigations.verification: Large/raw/model material is staged under /kaggle/tmp; final persistent hygiene scan rejects images, model files and .part files.

mitigations.issue: External acquisition lacked authoritative checksum binding and robust transport
mitigations.verification: Zenodo published checksums are mandatory; GVLiD source SHA-256 ledger is required; downloads use .part + retry + checksum + atomic replace.

mitigations.issue: Lineage relationship flag lacked a frozen evidence record
mitigations.verification: TRACKB_EXTERNAL_LINEAGE_REVIEW_v1 is pre-results frozen and SHA-bound; both candidates retain RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY.

mitigations.issue: Transport enumeration could influence scientific member identity
mitigations.verification: Canonical member naming binds raw SHA-256 plus source-member path digest; Mendeley duplicate transports are content-deduplicated.

mitigations.issue: Fresh reruns could forget an earlier protected-inference attempt
mitigations.verification: Private Kaggle attempt ledger records durable PROTECTED_INFERENCE_STARTED and subsequent states; rerun requires identical science preimage.

mitigations.issue: TRACK_B_CLOSED could be written before package verification
mitigations.verification: Independent QA -> stable science manifest -> ZIP build/CRC/member-hash verification -> package manifest -> closure.

mitigations.issue: Scientific identity mixed with execution timestamps/duration
mitigations.verification: Stable trackb_science_sha256 is separated from execution-instance closure_sha256.

mitigations.issue: Private Kaggle publication could be non-idempotent or incompletely verified
mitigations.verification: Content manifest/digest, identical-remote reuse, Ready-state poll and full terminal-evidence round-trip byte verification are implemented.

mitigations.issue: GitHub failure after scientific closure could encourage science rerun
mitigations.verification: Private archive is verified first; GitHub failure preserves closure and explicitly forbids science rerun.

mitigations.issue: Stale v2 readiness artifacts could be mistaken for current authority
mitigations.verification: TRACKB_EXECUTION_READINESS_v3 is the only current readiness artifact; v2 reports are retained as historical records only.

mitigations.issue: Repository-wide CI assumptions broke when Track-B notebooks/tests were added
mitigations.verification: Generic Python-3.11 suite installs compatible NumPy and Track-A canonical-notebook assertion excludes separately namespaced trackb_ notebooks.
